definition: Maximum integer t>=0 for which some pure symmetric n-qubit state has exactly the specified Majorana multiplicity partition and is t-anticoherent. Order0 is vacuous; maximum0 means no first-order state in this exact partition.
scope: All270 partitions for n2..12; exact states plus a finite-filter existence theorem and rigorous upper bounds. Ranges are not conjectured values.
